problem_context.expected_behavior: Starting at the supplied non-null node, traverse node_next until NULL and return the last node of that same nonempty chain.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Require linklist != 0 and xizi_sll(linklist,l). Ensure l decomposes as prefix ++ [return], return is non-null, and ownership is the prefix segment from the original start to return plus return->node_next == NULL.
spec_hint: This API starts at the supplied node itself, unlike head-based len/init. Keep xizi_sll rather than xizi_sll_head. The invariant should preserve an exact processed prefix/current-node/remaining-suffix decomposition.
preferred_hidden_properties: l = l1 ++ current :: l2, with xizi_sllseg(original,current,l1), current->next=next, and xizi_sll(next,l2); at next=NULL, l2=nil and current is the unique final element.
forbidden_patterns: Do not exclude the supplied node as a sentinel; do not weaken the postcondition to merely return a node with next=NULL; do not mirror traversal as a new Rocq algorithm.
